news.titleEn: Iran Attacks on Ships Raise Concerns Over Persian Gulf Oil Exports
news.conclusionEn: Iranian attacks on ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz have surged, and shipping sources say cargo flows may be slowing after recovering close to prewar levels earlier this month.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗袭船激增，霍尔木兹海峡原油外运恢复势头受威胁
news.whyEn: Hormuz carried roughly a fifth of global oil before the war; any renewed slowdown pushes up crude, fuel costs and inflation worldwide.
news.whyZh: 海峡承载全球约五分之一石油，运量再降将推高油价和全球通胀
news.detailEn: Gulf oil exports had been recovering thanks to an Arab-operated, US-assisted shuttle system that moves oil from small vessels to larger tankers. Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei has now called that shuttle an explicit target and also threatened US-linked cables and data centres in the region. Brent has been swinging around $100–108 a barrel, and a sustained disruption would undercut hopes that energy prices ease into year-end.
news.detailZh: 此前海湾原油出口靠一套由阿拉伯国家运营、美国协助的「驳运」系统逐步恢复，小船把油转到大型油轮上。伊朗安全事务负责人雷扎伊已宣布该驳运系统是明确打击目标，还威胁地区内与美国相关的海缆和数据中心。布伦特原油近期在每桶100至108美元间波动，如果运输持续受阻，年底能源价格回落的希望将落空。

news.titleEn: Chip Selloff Sparks 7% Korea Rout on Brewing Worries Over AI
news.conclusionEn: SK Hynix plunged more than 10% and Samsung fell about 7%, dragging South Korea's Kospi down roughly 5.5% at the close, as memory-chip stocks sold off globally.
news.conclusionZh: SK海力士跌超10%、三星跌约7%，韩国综指收跌约5.5%
news.whyEn: Memory chips are a core AI-trade bet; the rout hit Micron, SanDisk and others and shows how fragile AI sentiment has become.
news.whyZh: 存储芯片是AI交易核心，暴跌波及美光等股，显示AI情绪很脆弱
news.detailEn: Two triggers combined: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) said it made progress on a denser new memory architecture, raising competition fears, and Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said some AI investors were acting almost like they were in a casino. Micron fell about 3.6% in New York as the selloff spread to the US and Europe. Investors will watch upcoming results from TSMC and ASML for evidence on whether AI chip demand is still holding up.
news.detailZh: 两个因素叠加：中国长鑫存储（CXMT）宣布新型高密度存储架构取得进展，引发竞争担忧；博通CEO陈福阳又说部分AI投资者「几乎像在赌场里」。抛售蔓延到美欧市场，美光在纽约跌约3.6%。接下来台积电和ASML的财报将是检验AI芯片需求是否依然强劲的关键。

news.titleEn: World Economy Holds Up, Nears Limits of Resilience, IMF Says
news.conclusionEn: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1% and sees 3.4% in 2027, but warned that the world economy is nearing the limits of its resilience.
news.conclusionZh: IMF上调今年全球增长预期至3.1%，但警告韧性接近极限
news.whyEn: The IMF outlook frames policy debates for governments and central banks, and its 4.7% global inflation forecast signals rates may stay high.
news.whyZh: IMF预测影响各国政策走向，4.7%的通胀预期意味着利率或维持高位
news.detailEn: Released at the IMF/World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, the World Economic Outlook credits AI-related investment with giving the economy a demand boost in the first half. But the Middle East war's energy squeeze, trade tensions and shrinking fiscal buffers are eroding resilience. Global headline inflation is projected to rise to 4.7% this year before easing to 4.1% in 2027, and the outlook is increasingly uneven across countries.
news.detailZh: 这份《世界经济展望》在曼谷举行的IMF与世界银行年会上发布，认为AI相关投资在上半年给经济注入了需求动力。但中东战争带来的能源紧张、贸易摩擦和不断缩小的财政缓冲正在削弱韧性。全球整体通胀预计今年升至4.7%，2027年回落到4.1%，各国经济表现分化也越来越明显。

news.titleEn: JPMorgan Earnings: Surprise Drop in Fixed-Income Trading Revenue
news.conclusionEn: JPMorgan's third-quarter EPS of $5.57 and revenue of $50.91 billion missed forecasts, with its first drop in fixed-income trading revenue in over two years, though it raised its 2026 net interest income guidance.
news.conclusionZh: 摩根大通三季度业绩不及预期，固收交易收入意外下滑
news.whyEn: As the largest US bank and the kickoff to earnings season, JPMorgan's results shape views on Wall Street activity and the broader economy.
news.whyZh: 美国最大银行打响财报季，其业绩影响市场对华尔街和经济的判断
news.detailEn: Net income was $15.3 billion; analysts had expected $5.90 a share on about $51.2 billion of revenue. Investment banking revenue rose 14% from a year ago but fell 8% from an unusually busy second quarter, while executives said demand for capital to fund AI infrastructure remained insatiable. Higher interest rates helped lending income, which is why the bank lifted its full-year net interest income outlook.
news.detailZh: 摩根大通净利润153亿美元，而分析师原本预期每股收益5.90美元、营收约512亿美元。投行收入同比增长14%，但比异常火热的二季度下降8%；管理层表示为AI基础设施融资的资本需求「永无止境」。利率走高推升了贷款收入，因此银行上调了全年净利息收入指引。

news.titleEn: Trump's Russia Diesel Deal Fails to Lower US Fuel Prices, Analysts Say
news.conclusionEn: Analysts say Trump's six-month easing of restrictions on Russian diesel is too small to meaningfully lower fuel prices, even as it draws bipartisan criticism over sanctions.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普放宽俄罗斯柴油限制，分析称规模太小难压低油价
news.whyEn: The deal tests the credibility of Western sanctions on Russia and shows how high fuel prices are driving policy ahead of the US midterms.
news.whyZh: 此举考验对俄制裁的可信度，也显示中期选举前油价压力左右政策
news.detailEn: The arrangement, tied to an 'energy truce' covering Russian refineries, lets Russia supply diesel to US and global markets for six months. Goldman Sachs estimates the extra supply would cut wholesale diesel prices on the US Gulf Coast and in Europe by only $1 to $2 a barrel, and CNBC calculated it equals less than two weeks of US demand. Brent settled down 96 cents at $105.69 on Tuesday as Gulf supply risks limited losses.
news.detailZh: 这项安排与覆盖俄罗斯炼油厂的「能源停火」挂钩，允许俄罗斯在六个月内向美国和全球市场供应柴油。高盛估计新增供应只能让美国墨西哥湾沿岸和欧洲的柴油批发价每桶下降1到2美元，CNBC测算其规模不到美国两周的需求量。周二布伦特原油收跌96美分至105.69美元，海湾供应风险限制了跌幅。

news.titleEn: Saudi Arabia Intercepts New Houthi Missile Attacks on Riyadh
news.conclusionEn: Saudi Arabia intercepted more Houthi missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh, with falling debris injuring four people and damaging 15 homes.
news.conclusionZh: 沙特拦截胡塞武装对利雅得的新一轮导弹和无人机袭击
news.whyEn: Attacks on the Saudi capital and a fire at an Aramco building raise risks for the world's largest oil exporter and widen the regional war.
news.whyZh: 沙特首都遭袭、阿美建筑起火，全球最大石油出口国风险上升
news.detailEn: Saudi forces shot down two ballistic missiles and three drones north of Riyadh, the latest in several consecutive days of Houthi attacks; flights at Riyadh were also disrupted. A limited fire broke out in an administrative building at Aramco. Saudi Arabia has launched new strikes on the Houthis, who have threatened the US if it joins in, adding another front to the Iran war.
news.detailZh: 沙特军队在利雅得以北击落两枚弹道导弹和三架无人机，这是胡塞武装连续多日发动袭击中的最新一轮，利雅得航班也一度受影响。沙特阿美一栋行政楼发生小范围火灾。沙特已对胡塞武装发起新一轮空袭，胡塞则威胁若美国参战将予以打击，伊朗战争又多出一条战线。

news.titleEn: Waller Says Higher Treasury Yields Can Help Fed Cool Demand
news.conclusionEn: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said the surge in long-term Treasury yields is helping curb demand in rate-sensitive sectors such as housing and autos.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储理事沃勒称长债收益率上升有助于给需求降温
news.whyEn: It suggests markets may be doing part of the Fed's tightening job, which matters for whether the Fed hikes again this year.
news.whyZh: 暗示市场在替美联储「加息」，影响年内是否再次加息的判断
news.detailEn: The 10-year Treasury yield sits above 5.2% after the Fed raised rates to 3.75%–4.00% in September. Traders see only about a 21% chance of a hike this month but price in roughly an 88% chance of one in December. Investors are now focused on upcoming US inflation data, while the dollar hovers near an 18-month high and gold trades around $4,160 an ounce.
news.detailZh: 美联储9月加息至3.75%–4.00%后，10年期美债收益率维持在5.2%以上。交易员认为本月加息概率仅约21%，但12月加息概率高达约88%。市场目前聚焦即将公布的美国通胀数据，美元徘徊在18个月高点附近，金价约每盎司4160美元。

news.titleEn: The Trump administration warns Ukraine it could cut off intel, Zelenskyy tells NPR
news.conclusionEn: Zelenskyy told NPR the Trump administration warned it could cut off intelligence-sharing unless Ukraine stops long-range drone strikes on Russian oil refineries.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基称美方警告，若不停袭俄炼油厂将切断情报共享
news.whyEn: Ukraine's refinery strikes are one of its main levers against Russia's war economy, and they also affect global fuel supply.
news.whyZh: 袭击炼油厂是乌克兰打击俄战争经济的主要手段，也影响全球燃油供应
news.detailEn: The warning is linked to Trump's 'energy truce' covering Russian refineries, which Ukraine and Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz have criticised as too narrow. Zelenskyy has accused Russia of continuing to hit Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Losing US intelligence would sharply weaken Ukraine's ability to target deep inside Russia.
news.detailZh: 这一警告与特朗普宣布的覆盖俄罗斯炼油厂的「能源停火」有关，乌克兰和德国总理默茨都批评该停火范围过窄。泽连斯基此前指责俄罗斯仍在打击乌克兰能源设施。一旦失去美国情报支持，乌克兰对俄罗斯纵深目标的打击能力将大幅削弱。

news.titleEn: Microsoft to rely more on homegrown AI chips, reducing dependence on Nvidia
news.conclusionEn: Microsoft plans to make its in-house Maia chips its primary architecture for running AI models, with the next-generation Maia 300 entering production in 2027.
news.conclusionZh: 微软将以自研Maia芯片为主运行AI模型，减少对英伟达依赖
news.whyEn: Big cloud providers building their own chips threatens Nvidia's pricing power and could lower AI computing costs.
news.whyZh: 云巨头自研芯片会削弱英伟达定价权，并可能降低AI算力成本
news.detailEn: Microsoft says Maia 300 can process up to seven times more AI tokens per rack and 40% more tokens per megawatt than GPUs. It follows similar moves by Google and Amazon to design custom chips for inference. Microsoft shares have gained more than 50% from their June low and were on track for their first record close in nearly a year.
news.detailZh: 微软表示，Maia 300每个机架可处理的AI词元数量最多是GPU的7倍，每兆瓦处理量多40%。谷歌和亚马逊也在为AI推理设计定制芯片，微软此举与它们一致。微软股价已较6月低点上涨超过50%，有望创下近一年来首个收盘纪录。

news.titleEn: Wells Fargo Earnings Beat as Strong Customers Keep Lid on Loan Losses
news.conclusionEn: Wells Fargo earned $6.0 billion, or $1.87 a share, in the third quarter, beating estimates as loan losses came in better than expected.
news.conclusionZh: 富国银行三季度净利60亿美元超预期，贷款损失低于预期
news.whyEn: As a mainly consumer-focused lender, Wells Fargo's low loan losses signal US households and businesses are still holding up despite high rates.
news.whyZh: 富国以零售业务为主，坏账可控说明高利率下美国家庭企业仍稳健
news.detailEn: Both the provision for credit losses and net charge-offs were better than analysts expected. Goldman Sachs also reported revenue of $18.68 billion, well above estimates, and Citigroup had its best third-quarter revenue in a decade. Together the results suggest higher rates are lifting bank lending income while credit quality remains intact; Bank of America reports on Wednesday.
news.detailZh: 富国的信贷损失拨备和净冲销都好于分析师预期。同日高盛营收186.8亿美元，远超预期；花旗则录得十年来最好的三季度营收。整体来看，高利率在推高银行贷款收入，同时信贷质量保持稳定；美国银行将于周三公布财报。

businessTips.explanationEn: Operating leverage measures how much profit changes when revenue changes, and it depends on how much of a company's costs are fixed. A business with high fixed costs (software, factories, airlines) sees profits jump when sales rise, because each extra dollar of revenue carries little extra cost. The flip side is that profits fall just as sharply when sales drop. Managers say they achieved 'positive operating leverage' when revenue grows faster than expenses.
businessTips.explanationZh: 经营杠杆衡量营收变化时利润会变化多少，取决于公司成本中固定成本的比例。固定成本高的企业（软件、工厂、航空公司）在销售增长时利润会大幅跳升，因为每多一块钱收入几乎不增加成本。反过来，销售下滑时利润也会同样剧烈地下降。当营收增速超过费用增速时，管理层就会说实现了「正经营杠杆」。
businessTips.exampleEn: Citigroup highlighted positive operating leverage this quarter: revenue grew faster than costs, so profit margins widened. A SaaS company that spends $10 million a year on engineering can add thousands of customers with almost no extra cost, so a 20% revenue increase might lift profit by 50% or more.
businessTips.exampleZh: 花旗本季度特别强调实现了正经营杠杆：营收增长快于成本，利润率因此扩大。一家每年在研发上花1000万美元的SaaS公司，新增几千个客户几乎不增加成本，所以营收增长20%可能带来利润增长50%以上。

businessTips.explanationEn: Platform risk is the danger of building a business that depends on a single platform you don't control, such as Amazon, Etsy, YouTube, TikTok or an app store. A change in algorithm, fees or policy, or an account suspension, can cut your income overnight. Many side businesses start on platforms because that is where the customers are, which is fine as long as you plan for the risk. The fix is to diversify channels and move customers onto assets you own.
businessTips.explanationZh: 平台风险指你的生意依赖一个你无法控制的平台，比如亚马逊、Etsy、YouTube、抖音或应用商店。平台调整算法、费率或规则，甚至封号，都可能让你的收入一夜归零。很多副业一开始都在平台上做，因为客户在那里，这本身没问题，但必须提前防范风险。解决办法是分散渠道，并把客户转移到自己掌握的资产上。
businessTips.exampleEn: An Etsy seller earning $3,000 a month could add a simple Shopify store and include a discount card in every package inviting buyers to join an email list. If Etsy raises fees or the listing loses search ranking, the seller can still reach repeat customers directly.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个每月在Etsy赚3000美元的卖家，可以另开一个简单的Shopify店，并在每个包裹里放一张优惠卡，邀请买家订阅邮件列表。这样即使Etsy涨价或商品搜索排名下降，卖家依然能直接联系到回头客。

businessTips.term: Net Interest Income (NII) & Net Interest Margin (NIM)
businessTips.explanationEn: Net interest income is the money a bank earns on loans and securities minus what it pays depositors and other lenders; it is the core profit engine of most banks. Net interest margin expresses that income as a percentage of interest-earning assets. Rising rates often lift NII because loan yields reset faster than deposit costs, but if depositors demand higher rates or loan demand weakens, margins can shrink. NII guidance is one of the most closely watched numbers in bank earnings.
businessTips.explanationZh: 净利息收入是银行从贷款和证券上赚的利息，减去支付给储户和其他债权人的利息，是大多数银行的核心利润来源。净息差则是把这部分收入表示为生息资产的百分比。利率上升时贷款收益率往往比存款成本调整得更快，因此净利息收入通常会增加；但如果储户要求更高利息或贷款需求减弱，息差就会收窄。净利息收入指引是银行财报中最受关注的数字之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week JPMorgan missed profit forecasts but raised its 2026 NII guidance, which helped soften the blow for investors. If a bank earns 6% on loans and pays 3% on deposits, its spread is 3 percentage points; if deposit costs rise to 4% while loan yields stay put, NII falls even if the loan book grows.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周摩根大通利润不及预期，但上调了2026年净利息收入指引，这在一定程度上缓解了投资者的失望。假设银行贷款收益率6%、存款成本3%，利差就是3个百分点；如果存款成本升到4%而贷款收益率不变，即使贷款规模增长，净利息收入也可能下降。
